title: Constant-factor hardness of uniform sparsest cut
summary: We prove that, for every fixed C > 1, approximating Uniform Sparsest Cut within factor C is NP-hard. The output graphs have nonnegative rational capacities and unit demand between every pair of distinct vertices.
family_title: Uniform sparsest cut: hardness and semidefinite gaps

review.reason: Proves NP-hardness of approximating Uniform Sparsest Cut within any fixed constant factor.
